name: swipe-deck
title: Swipe Deck
description: Swipe through a stack of art prints to reveal the next poster.
usage: <SwipeDeck cards={[{ title: "Orbit", color: "#bed5ce", ink: "#20312a" }, { title: "Fold", color: "#dbcfbd", ink: "#30271c" }]} />
useCases: On a portfolio page, a visitor swipes through a poster series one piece at a time.
When shortlisting covers, an editor swipes a candidate right to keep it. The app records the card and direction from onSwipe.
task: Swipe through a stack of art prints to reveal the next poster.
behavior: Pass cards in display order. onSwipe receives the card object and the direction left or right.
